import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np

# Read the data
data = pd.read_csv('data.csv')

# Create a figure with multiple subplots
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(16, 12))
gs = fig.add_gridspec(3, 3, hspace=0.3, wspace=0.3)

# Set style
sns.set_style("whitegrid")
colors = sns.color_palette("husl", 8)

# 1. Sleep Duration by Occupation
ax1 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 0])
occupation_sleep = data.groupby('Occupation')['Sleep Duration'].mean().sort_values()
ax1.barh(range(len(occupation_sleep)), occupation_sleep.values, color=colors[0])
ax1.set_yticks(range(len(occupation_sleep)))
ax1.set_yticklabels(occupation_sleep.index, fontsize=8)
ax1.set_xlabel('Avg Sleep Duration (hrs)', fontsize=9)
ax1.set_title('Sleep Duration by Occupation', fontsize=10, fontweight='bold')

# 2. Quality of Sleep vs Stress Level
ax2 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 1])
scatter = ax2.scatter(data['Stress Level'], data['Quality of Sleep'], 
                     c=data['Age'], cmap='viridis', alpha=0.6, s=100)
ax2.set_xlabel('Stress Level', fontsize=9)
ax2.set_ylabel('Quality of Sleep', fontsize=9)
ax2.set_title('Sleep Quality vs Stress Level', fontsize=10, fontweight='bold')
cbar = plt.colorbar(scatter, ax=ax2)
cbar.set_label('Age', fontsize=8)

# 3. BMI Category Distribution
ax3 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 2])
bmi_counts = data['BMI Category'].value_counts()
ax3.pie(bmi_counts.values, labels=bmi_counts.index, autopct='%1.1f%%',
        colors=colors[2:5], startangle=90)
ax3.set_title('BMI Category Distribution', fontsize=10, fontweight='bold')

# 4. Physical Activity Level by Gender
ax4 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 0])
gender_activity = data.groupby('Gender')['Physical Activity Level'].mean()
ax4.bar(gender_activity.index, gender_activity.values, color=colors[1], alpha=0.7)
ax4.set_ylabel('Avg Physical Activity Level', fontsize=9)
ax4.set_title('Physical Activity by Gender', fontsize=10, fontweight='bold')

# 5. Daily Steps Distribution
ax5 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 1])
ax5.hist(data['Daily Steps'], bins=15, color=colors[3], alpha=0.7, edgecolor='black')
ax5.set_xlabel('Daily Steps', fontsize=9)
ax5.set_ylabel('Frequency', fontsize=9)
ax5.set_title('Daily Steps Distribution', fontsize=10, fontweight='bold')

# 6. Sleep Disorder Distribution
ax6 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 2])
disorder_counts = data['Sleep Disorder'].fillna('None').value_counts()
ax6.bar(range(len(disorder_counts)), disorder_counts.values, color=colors[4], alpha=0.7)
ax6.set_xticks(range(len(disorder_counts)))
ax6.set_xticklabels(disorder_counts.index, rotation=45, ha='right', fontsize=8)
ax6.set_ylabel('Count', fontsize=9)
ax6.set_title('Sleep Disorder Distribution', fontsize=10, fontweight='bold')

# 7. Heart Rate vs Age
ax7 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, 0])
ax7.scatter(data['Age'], data['Heart Rate'], c=colors[5], alpha=0.6, s=100)
ax7.set_xlabel('Age', fontsize=9)
ax7.set_ylabel('Heart Rate (bpm)', fontsize=9)
ax7.set_title('Heart Rate vs Age', fontsize=10, fontweight='bold')

# 8. Correlation Heatmap
ax8 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, 1:])
numeric_cols = ['Age', 'Sleep Duration', 'Quality of Sleep', 'Physical Activity Level', 
                'Stress Level', 'Heart Rate', 'Daily Steps']
corr_matrix = data[numeric_cols].corr()
sns.heatmap(corr_matrix, annot=True, fmt='.2f', cmap='coolwarm', center=0,
            ax=ax8, cbar_kws={'shrink': 0.8})
ax8.set_title('Correlation Matrix of Key Variables', fontsize=10, fontweight='bold')
plt.setp(ax8.get_xticklabels(), rotation=45, ha='right', fontsize=8)
plt.setp(ax8.get_yticklabels(), rotation=0, fontsize=8)

# Overall title
fig.suptitle('Sleep and Health Analysis Dashboard', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=0.995)

plt.savefig('output.png', dpi=300, bbox_inches='tight')
plt.close()
